words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: Please shut the door.
words.ex_cn: 请关上门。
words.en: To shut something means to move it so that it fills an opening or to move it so that it is no longer open.

words.ex: The rose has a sharp thorn.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰有一根尖刺。
words.en: A thorn is a sharp, pointed projection on the stem or other part of a plant.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.tr:
adj. 马克思主义的
n. 马克思主义者
words.ex: He is a Marxist who believes in workers' rights.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位相信工人权利的马克思主义者。
words.en: A Marxist is someone who believes in the political and economic theories of Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels, especially the idea that capitalism will inevitably be replaced by socialism and then communism.

words.tr: adj. 古怪的；难以解释的
words.ex: He is queer and proud of who he is.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，并为自己是谁而自豪。
words.en: Queer is used to describe something that is strange or unusual, or someone who is homosexual.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门拍了一张照片。
words.en: A shutter is a device used to cover or uncover a window or a camera lens.

words.tr:
num. 一千；
n. 千；千个；
words.ex: There are a thousand stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有一千颗星星。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of a hundred and ten; 1,000.

words.ex: He held a pistol in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着一把手枪。
words.en: A pistol is a small gun.

words.ex: The doctor explained the disease in layman terms.
words.ex_cn: 医生用通俗易懂的语言解释了这种疾病。
words.en: A layman is a person who does not have specialized or professional knowledge of a subject.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.tr:
n. 询问；疑问；问号
v. 询问；怀疑
words.ex: He made a query about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了公交车的时刻表。
words.en: A query is a question, especially one that you ask in order to check that something is true or correct.

words.ex: He will rectify the mistake tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会纠正这个错误。
words.en: If you rectify something that is wrong, you change it so that it becomes correct or satisfactory.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: He works on a naval ship.
words.ex_cn: 他在一艘军舰上工作。
words.en: Naval means relating to the navy, especially to ships that are used in war.

words.tr:
n. 长队；
v. 排队；
words.ex: There is a long queue at the ticket counter.
words.ex_cn: 售票处排着一条长队。
words.en: A queue is a line of people or vehicles waiting for something.

words.ex: The extra chair is redundant because we have enough seats.
words.ex_cn: 这把额外的椅子是多余的，因为我们已经有足够的座位了。
words.en: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because there is no more work for you.

words.ex: The shy boy didn't speak in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩在课堂上没有说话。
words.en: If you are shy, you are nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

words.ex: This plan is viable and can be done with little money.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且用很少的钱就能完成。
words.en: If something is viable, it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.tr: n. 马拉松赛跑；耐力赛；
words.ex: He ran a marathon last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他上个星期日跑了一场马拉松赛跑。
words.en: A marathon is a long-distance running event with an official distance of 42.195 kilometers (26 miles 385 yards), usually run as a road race. The event was instituted in commemoration of the fabled run of the Greek soldier Pheidippides, a messenger from the Battle of Marathon to Athens.

words.ex: The ship uses GPS for navigation.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用GPS进行导航。
words.en: The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.tr:
v. 颤抖；颤动；发抖
n. 颤抖
words.ex: The leaf quivers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在风中颤抖。
words.en: To shake or tremble with a slight rapid motion; a case for carrying arrows.

words.ex: The reed grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 芦苇长在河边。
words.en: A reed is a tall, thin plant that grows in water or marshy ground.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: The phone vibrates when it receives a call.
words.ex_cn: 当手机收到电话时，它会震动。
words.en: To vibrate means to move rapidly to and fro or up and down; to oscillate.

words.ex: He was punished for plagiarism in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他因论文剽窃而受到惩罚。
words.en: Plagiarism is the practice of using or copying someone else's idea or work and pretending that you thought of it or created it.

words.ex: The statue is made of white marble.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由白色大理石制成。
words.en: Marble is a type of very hard rock which is used for making statues and for building. It is usually white with dark lines in it.

words.ex: He joined the navy after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了海军。
words.en: The navy is the part of a country's armed forces that is trained to operate at sea.

words.ex: The students participated in a history quiz at school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了学校举办的历史知识竞赛。
words.en: A quiz is a test or a game in which someone asks you questions to find out how much you know about a subject.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reel.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕在卷筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. It can also refer to a lively Scottish or Irish dance, or to the act of staggering or lurching violently.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.ex: My birthday is in March.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在三月。
words.en: March is the third month of the Gregorian calendar, following February and preceding April.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.ex: The factory has a quota of 1000 units per day.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每天有1000件的配额。
words.en: A quota is the limited number or quantity of something which is officially allowed.

words.ex: It was sheer luck that he won the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了比赛完全是运气。
words.en: Sheer is used to emphasize that a state or situation is complete and does not involve or is not mixed with anything else.

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.tr:
n. 平原；
adj. 简单明了的；朴素的；
words.ex: The cows graze on the plain.
words.ex_cn: 牛在平原上吃草。
words.en: If something is plain, it is easy to see, hear, or understand.

words.ex: The marine birds fly over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海鸟在海面上飞翔。
words.en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the ships and boats which sail on it.

words.ex: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上差点没赶上公交车。
words.en: Almost, but not quite; very close to.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: He violated the school rule by using his phone in class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课使用手机，违反了校规。
words.en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: They are discussing marital problems.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在讨论婚姻问题。
words.en: Marital is used to describe things relating to marriage.

words.tr: adj. 整洁的；整齐的；有条理的
words.ex: He keeps his desk neat.
words.ex_cn: 他保持书桌整洁。
words.en: Neat things are tidy, smart, or carefully arranged.

words.ex: I can't recollect where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我想不起来把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you recollect something, you remember it.

words.ex: The shepherd walks with his sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧羊人每天早上都带着他的羊走路。
words.en: A shepherd is a person whose job is to look after sheep. As a verb, it means to guide or direct someone or something in a particular direction.

words.ex: His thesis is that exercise improves memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点是锻炼能改善记忆力。
words.en: A thesis is a long piece of writing based on your own ideas and research that you do as part of a university degree, especially a higher degree such as a PhD.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.tr: adj. 已婚的； v. 结婚；“marry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They are married and have two children.
words.ex_cn: 他们已婚，有两个孩子。
words.en: Having a husband or wife; united in matrimony.

words.ex: She wears a gold necklace every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都戴一条金项链。
words.en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears around their neck.

words.ex: He tried to reconcile his work and family life.
words.ex_cn: 他试图调和工作与家庭生活。
words.en: If you reconcile two beliefs, facts, or demands that seem to be opposed or completely different, you find a way in which they can both be true or both be successful.

words.tr: adj. 精明的；敏锐的；机灵的；
words.ex: He made a shrewd decision to buy the house low.
words.ex_cn: 他精明地决定低价买下这栋房子。
words.en: A shrewd person is able to understand and judge a situation quickly and to use this understanding to their own advantage.

words.ex: The book has a thick cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有厚厚的封面。
words.en: Having a large distance between the top and bottom or front and back surfaces; not thin.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The virus is infectious and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒具有传染性，传播迅速。
words.en: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air they breathe.

words.ex: The countries formed a peace league.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个和平联盟。
words.en: A league is a group of people, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a particular purpose, or because they share a common interest.

words.ex: Reading gives me great pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 阅读带给我极大的快乐。
words.en: Pleasure is a feeling of happiness, satisfaction, or enjoyment.

words.ex: The queen's reign lasted 70 years.
words.ex_cn: 女王的统治持续了70年。
words.en: The period during which a sovereign rules; to hold royal office; to prevail

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.ex: The cat is beneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: In or to a lower position than someone or something, under someone or something.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.tr:
n. 漏洞；泄露；
v. 漏；泄露；
words.ex: The leak in the roof caused water to drip inside.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的漏洞导致水滴进屋里。
words.en: If a container or pipe leaks, or if it leaks a substance such as liquid or gas, the substance comes out of it accidentally because there is a hole or crack in it.

words.ex: He made a pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了帮助穷人的保证。
words.en: A pledge is a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially. It can also refer to something given as security for the fulfillment of a contract or the payment of a debt.

words.tr:
n. 缰绳；驾驭；控制
v. 控制；驾驭
words.ex: He uses a leather rein to control the horse.
words.ex_cn: 他用皮缰绳来控制马。
words.en: A rein is a long, narrow strap attached at one end to a horse's bit, typically used in pairs to guide or check a horse while riding or driving.

words.tr:
v. 给…打钩；发出滴嗒声；
n. 钩号；
words.ex: Please tick the box if you agree.
words.ex_cn: 如果你同意，请在方框里打钩。
words.en: The word 'tick' can refer to the sound a clock makes, a very short period of time, a mark used to indicate something, or a type of small insect. As a verb, it can mean to make a ticking sound or to mark something with a tick.

words.ex: The workers unload the boxes from the truck.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从卡车上卸下箱子。
words.en: To remove goods from a vehicle, ship, container, etc.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.ex: The price of bread went up because of inflation.
words.ex_cn: 由于通货膨胀，面包的价格上涨了。
words.en: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.ex: There are plentiful apples in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 篮子里有丰富的苹果。
words.en: If something is plentiful, there is a lot of it available.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.tr: v. 把…强加给；使遭受；使承受
words.ex: The storm inflicted heavy damage on the village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴给村庄造成了严重破坏。
words.en: If you inflict something unpleasant on someone, you make them suffer it.

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.ex: He got pneumonia after a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他得了重感冒后患了肺炎。
words.en: Pneumonia is a serious disease which affects your lungs and makes it difficult for you to breathe.

words.ex: The game simulates real traffic conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏模拟了真实的交通状况。
words.en: To simulate is to create a model or representation of a situation, process, or system for the purpose of study, analysis, or training. It involves imitating the conditions of a real event or environment to understand its effects or to practice responses to it.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.tr:
adj. 竖直的；直立的；
adv. 笔直地；
words.ex: The picture is hanging upright on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画垂直地挂在墙上。
words.en: If you are sitting or standing upright, you are sitting or standing with your back straight, rather than bending or lying down.

words.ex: The speaker will amplify the sound for everyone to hear.
words.ex_cn: 扬声器会放大声音，让每个人都能听到。
words.en: To amplify something means to make it louder, stronger, or more detailed.

words.tr:
adj. 红外线的
n. 红外线
words.ex: The remote uses infrared to change the TV channel.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器使用红外线来切换电视频道。
words.en: Infrared refers to the region of the electromagnetic spectrum with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than microwaves, often used in technology for night vision and heat sensing.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: He put the keys in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙放进了口袋里。
words.en: A pocket is a small bag sewn into or on clothing so that you can carry small objects such as money or keys in it.

words.ex: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生了。
words.en: Happening, existing, or done at the same time.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼去睡觉了。
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.ex: An analog clock has hands that move in a circle.
words.ex_cn: 模拟时钟有在圆圈中移动的指针。
words.en: An analog(ue) is something that is similar to something else in some way, often used to explain or clarify a concept.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.

words.ex: He felt guilt for his sin of lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因撒谎的罪行感到内疚。
words.en: Sin is an action or behaviour that is considered to be morally wrong according to religious or social laws.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.tr:
adv. 向上地；
adj. 向上的；
words.ex: The balloon moved upward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 气球缓慢地向上移动。
words.en: Moving or directed toward a higher place or level.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
words.en: The knee is the joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.ex: He gave a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地道歉了。
words.en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

words.tr: phrase. 分析；解析（等于美式拼写 analyze）
words.ex: He tries to analyse the data carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他试图仔细分析这些数据。
words.en: To examine something in detail using systematic methods and critical thinking.

words.ex: He kneel to pray every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跪下祈祷。
words.en: To kneel means to go down into a position where one or both knees are on the ground.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.tr:
v. 看待；有关；
n. 尊敬；致意；
words.ex: I regard him as a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他看作好朋友。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.tr: adj. 单一的；单独的；单身的；
words.ex: He bought a single ticket for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张单程公交车票。
words.en: Only one in number; one only; not married or not involved in a stable romantic relationship.

words.ex: He uses the web to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网络来查找信息。
words.en: A web is a thin net made from sticky threads that a spider uses to catch insects.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: He turned the knob to adjust the volume.
words.ex_cn: 他转动旋钮来调节音量。
words.en: A knob is a round handle, or a round switch on a piece of equipment.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. 看待；“regard”的现在分词；
words.ex: He sent me an email regarding the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给我发了一封关于会议的邮件。
words.en: You can use regarding to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.tr: adj. 单个的；单数的；特异的；
words.ex: Each singular student must submit a form.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都必须提交一份表格。
words.en: In grammar, singular means relating to or being a form of a word that refers to one person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 楔子；三角木；楔形物
v. 把…楔住 ；将…挤入（或塞进、插入）
words.ex: He used a wedge to split the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用楔子把木头劈开。
words.en: A wedge is a piece of wood, metal, or other material with one thick end and one thin edge, used to keep something in position or to split something apart.

words.ex: He has an analytic mind and solves problems step by step.
words.ex_cn: 他有分析性的思维，能一步一步解决问题。
words.en: relating to or using analysis or logical reasoning.

words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. It can also refer to a hard mass formed in a tree trunk at the intersection with a branch, or a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, used especially by ships and aircraft.

words.ex: His nickname is 'Speedy' because he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的绰号是‘飞毛腿’，因为他跑得快。
words.en: A nickname is an informal name for someone or something, especially a name that you are called by your friends or family, usually based on your real name or your character.

words.ex: He went outside regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨就出去了。
words.en: If you say that someone does something regardless, you mean that they do it without taking account of the possible problems or difficulties.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.ex: The ball keeps moving because of inertia.
words.ex_cn: 球因为惯性继续移动。
words.en: Inertia is the tendency of a physical object to continue moving in a straight line at a constant speed, or to stay at rest, unless it is acted upon by a force.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

words.tr:
n. 一小口；
v. 呷；啜；小口喝；
words.ex: He took a sip of water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一小口水。
words.en: To drink something slowly by taking small amounts into your mouth.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.tr:
n. 婴儿；
adj. 初期的；
words.ex: The infant is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: An infant is a baby or very young child.

words.ex: The green leaf fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 绿叶从树上落了下来。
words.en: A leaf is one of the flat, usually green parts of a plant that are joined to its stem or branches.

words.ex: He accepted a nominal fee for the service.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项服务收取了微不足道的费用。
words.en: If you say that something is nominal, you mean that it is very small in comparison to the real value or importance of something.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: The siren sounded loudly as the fire truck rushed by.
words.ex_cn: 消防车疾驰而过时，警报器发出了响亮的声音。
words.en: A siren is a device that makes a loud prolonged sound as a signal or warning. It can also refer to a woman who is considered to be alluring or fascinating but also dangerous.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.ex: The virus can infect people quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒能迅速感染人。
words.en: To infect someone or something means to cause them to have a disease or illness.

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.ex: They will nominate her for the award.
words.ex_cn: 他们将提名她获得这个奖项。
words.en: If someone is nominated for a job or position, their name is formally suggested as a candidate for it.

words.ex: The actors rehearse their lines every evening.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天晚上排练他们的台词。
words.en: To rehearse means to practice a play, piece of music, or other work for later public performance.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.tr:
adj. 青少年的；幼稚的；
n. 少年；
words.ex: The book is written for juvenile readers.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为青少年读者撰写的。
words.en: A juvenile is a child or young person who is not yet old enough to be considered an adult.

words.ex: He begs for food on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上乞讨食物。
words.en: If you beg someone to do something, you ask them very anxiously or eagerly to do it.

words.tr:
prep. 沿着；
adv. 沿着；
words.ex: We walked along the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着河走。
words.en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

words.ex: Please fetch me a glass of water.
words.ex_cn: 请给我拿一杯水来。
words.en: If you fetch something or someone, you go to the place where they are and return with them.

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是动物王国之王。
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.tr: adj. 不透明的；难懂的；晦涩的
words.ex: The glass is opaque, so I cannot see through it.
words.ex_cn: 这扇玻璃是不透明的，所以我看不到它后面的东西。
words.en: If an object or substance is opaque, you cannot see through it.

words.ex: The refugee walked to a new country.
words.ex_cn: 这名难民步行去了一个新国家。
words.en: A refugee is a person who has been forced to leave their country in order to escape war, persecution, or natural disaster.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着河边走。
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.tr: adj. 封建的；封建制度的
words.ex: The land was owned by feudal lords.
words.ex_cn: 土地由封建领主拥有。
words.en: Relating to, resembling, or characteristic of feudalism.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: He opted to stay home instead of going out.
words.ex_cn: 他选择待在家里而不是出去。
words.en: If you opt for something, or opt to do something, you choose it or decide to do it in preference to anything else.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.ex: The goat eats grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 山羊在田野里吃草。
words.en: A goat is a farm animal or a wild animal that is about the size of a sheep. Goats have horns, and some have long hair.

words.tr: v. “be”的现在分词；是；在； n. 存在；生物；人；生命；
words.ex: He is being quiet in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他正在图书馆里保持安静。
words.en: The state or quality of having existence.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.ex: He has a high fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，躺在床上休息。
words.en: A fever is a condition in which the body's temperature is higher than usual, often as a response to infection.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

words.ex: His refusal to apologize made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝道歉，让所有人都生气了。
words.en: The act of refusing to do something or to accept something.

words.tr:
n. 金；金币；金黄色；
adj. 金色的；
words.ex: He bought a gold ring for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为妻子买了一枚金戒指。
words.en: Gold is a valuable, yellow-colored metal that is used for making jewelry and as an international currency.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.tr: v. 公开指责；告发；揭发
words.ex: He denounces corruption in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中谴责腐败。
words.en: If you denounce a person or an action, you criticize them severely and publicly because you feel strongly that they are wrong or evil.

words.tr:
v. 举起；投掷；起伏；喘息；呕吐
n. 举；投；掷；起伏
words.ex: He heave the box onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子举到了桌子上。
words.en: To lift or haul something heavy with great effort; to throw something forcefully; to rise and fall rhythmically or with effort.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.tr:
n. 灰泥；
v. 涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；
words.ex: The wall was covered with white plaster.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁上覆盖着白色灰泥。
words.en: A substance applied to walls or ceilings to smooth or decorate them, or a medical dressing used to cover wounds.

words.ex: He refused to eat the broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

words.ex: The golden sun set behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 金色的太阳在山后落下。
words.en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in color, like gold. It can also describe something that is very good or valuable.

words.ex: He alleges that the manager stole money.
words.ex_cn: 他声称经理偷了钱。
words.en: If you allege that something bad is true, you say it but do not prove it.

words.ex: The forest is dense with trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林树木茂密。
words.en: Something that is dense contains a lot of things or people in a small area.

words.ex: He believes he will go to heaven after death.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己死后会去天堂。
words.en: In some religions, heaven is the place where God or the gods live and where good people go after they die.

words.ex: My birthday is in May.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在五月。
words.en: May is the fifth month of the Gregorian calendar, following April and preceding June.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.ex: He swore allegiance to his country.
words.ex_cn: 他向自己的国家宣誓效忠。
words.en: Loyalty or commitment to a superior or to a group or cause.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子很重。
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.tr: n. 回路；环行；电路；巡回；
words.ex: The battery connects to the circuit to make the light work.
words.ex_cn: 电池连接到回路，使灯亮起来。
words.en: A circuit is a roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place. It can also refer to the complete path that an electric current travels along.

words.ex: She walked with grace across the stage.
words.ex_cn: 她优雅地走过舞台。
words.en: Grace is the quality of being pleasant, polite, and dignified, or a period of time allowed for something to be done.

words.ex: Drugs can alleviate pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To make something less severe or intense.

words.tr:
n. 同事；（组织的）会员；家伙；同胞；
adj. 同类的；同事的；
words.ex: He works as a fellow with Dr. Smith in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里与史密斯博士一起工作，是他的同事。
words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.ex: We played chess indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们在室内下棋。
words.en: Located, done, or used inside a building.

words.tr:
n. 窝；鸟巢；
v. 筑巢；
words.ex: The bird built a nest in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在树上筑了一个窝。
words.en: A nest is a structure made by a bird for laying eggs and sheltering its young. It can also refer to a place where insects or other animals lay eggs or raise their young. As a verb, to nest means to build or use a nest.

words.ex: The sheep graze on a high plateau.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在高高原上吃草。
words.en: A plateau is a large area of high and fairly flat land. It can also refer to a period during which there are no large changes.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.tr: adj. 优雅的；优美的；得体的；
words.ex: The dancer moved in a graceful way.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者动作优雅。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as graceful, you mean that they move in a smooth, controlled, and attractive way.

words.ex: The two countries formed an alliance to fight the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成联盟以对抗敌人。
words.en: An alliance is a group of countries or political parties that are formally united and working together because they have similar aims.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；情谊；团体；联谊会；研究生奖学金
words.ex: They formed a fellowship to work on the project together.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了伙伴关系一起来做这个项目。
words.en: A fellowship is a group of people who join together for a common purpose or interest, or a financial grant given to a scholar to allow them to study or research at an advanced level.

words.ex: The ad induced him to buy the product.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告诱使他购买了该产品。
words.en: To induce a state or condition means to cause it.

words.tr:
adj. 净余的；
n. 网；
words.ex: The net profit after taxes is $500.
words.ex_cn: 缴税后的净收益是500美元。
words.en: A net is a piece of thin fabric or thread that is used to catch fish, insects, or other small animals. It can also refer to the amount of money remaining after all expenses have been deducted.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: Blood circulates in the body.
words.ex_cn: 血液在体内循环。
words.en: To move or cause to move continuously or freely through a closed system or area.

words.tr: adj. 亲切的；和蔼的；仁慈的
words.ex: She was gracious and thanked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 她很友善，感谢了每一个人。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially someone you think is superior to you, as gracious, you mean that they are very well-mannered and pleasant.

words.ex: My parents give me a weekly allowance.
words.ex_cn: 我父母每周给我零用钱。
words.en: An allowance is money that is given regularly, usually to a child, by their parents, or by the government to someone who is unemployed or ill.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.ex: Parents shouldn't indulge their children's bad habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母不应该放任孩子的坏习惯。
words.en: To indulge means to allow yourself or someone else to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you.

words.tr: n. 网络；网状物；体系；联络网
words.ex: The internet is a big netwom.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的网络。
words.en: A misspelling of 'network', referring to a group of interconnected people or things.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.ex: Every citizen must follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都必须遵守法律。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a country or state, either by birth or by naturalization, and who is entitled to its protection and privileges.

words.tr:
n. 合金
v. 把…铸成合金
words.ex: He made a strong alloy from copper and zinc.
words.ex_cn: 他用铜和锌制造了一种坚固的合金。
words.en: An alloy is a metal made by combining two or more metallic elements, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion.

words.ex: She has a feminine voice.
words.ex_cn: 她的声音很女性化。
words.en: having qualities or an appearance traditionally associated with women, especially delicacy and prettiness.

words.ex: She invited all her kin to the family reunion.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请了所有亲属参加家庭聚会。
words.en: Your kin are your relatives.

words.tr: adj. 中性的；无偏见的；中立的
words.ex: The color white is often seen as neutral.
words.ex_cn: 白色通常被视为中性的。
words.en: A misspelling of 'neutral', meaning not supporting or favoring either side in a conflict or debate.

words.ex: He refines his writing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天完善自己的写作。
words.en: To refine something means to make it purer or to improve it, especially by removing unwanted substances or by making small changes.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.ex: France was an ally of the United States in the war.
words.ex_cn: 法国在战争中是美国的同盟者。
words.en: An ally is a country, organization, or person that helps and supports another country, organization, or person in a difficult situation.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.ex: Her kindness helped me when I was sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我不开心时，她的善意帮助了我。
words.en: Kindness is the quality of being gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.ex: He bought a new bike yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Recently made, invented, introduced, or discovered; not existing before.

words.tr:
n. 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）；叠句；
v. 克制；
words.ex: His constant refrain is that the food is too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他经常抱怨食物太贵。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.ex: The civilian population stayed safe during the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 平民在冲突期间保持安全。
words.en: A civilian is a person who is not a member of the military or of a police or firefighting force.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在公园里散步。
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the head of state of that country.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: The animals found refuge in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物在森林中找到了避难所。
words.en: A place or state of safety or shelter from danger, trouble, or difficulty.

words.tr: v. 使开化；使文明；教化
words.ex: They tried to civilize the wild tribe.
words.ex_cn: 他们试图使这个原始部落文明化。
words.en: To civilize means to bring a place or people to a stage of social, cultural, and moral development considered to be more advanced.

words.ex: He likes to skate on the ice every winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每年冬天在冰上溜冰。
words.en: To move over a surface on skates, or to perform a sport that involves moving on skates.

words.ex: He rolled up his sleeve to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他卷起袖子洗手。
words.en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.

words.ex: The sun descends behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在山后落下。
words.en: If you descend or if you descend a staircase, you move downwards from a higher to a lower level.

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.ex: The baby smiled at the sweet melody.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝听到了甜美的旋律，笑了。
words.en: A melody is a sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.ex: This tool is useful for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对解决数学问题很有用。
words.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

words.ex: He likes to ski in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里滑雪。
words.en: A ski is one of a pair of long, flat runners attached to the feet for gliding over snow. Skiing is the activity of gliding over snow on skis.

words.ex: She has a slender figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: Someone or something that is slender is thin and graceful.

words.ex: He is a descendant of the first king.
words.ex_cn: 他是第一位国王的后裔。
words.en: A person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor.

words.ex: The cook wiped off the grease from the pan.
words.ex_cn: 厨师把锅上的油脂擦掉了。
words.en: Grease is a thick, oily substance which is put on the moving parts of cars and other machines in order to make them work smoothly.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.ex: He listens to music to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他听音乐来放松。
words.en: If you relax or if something relaxes you, you feel more calm and less worried or tense.

words.ex: He showed the utmost care when handling the fragile glass.
words.ex_cn: 他在处理易碎的玻璃时表现出了最大的小心。
words.en: The greatest or highest degree of something.

words.ex: She is a skillful painter.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个技艺高超的画家。
words.en: Possessing or showing skill and expertise in a particular activity.

words.tr: n. 切片；薄片；部分；片段；
words.ex: She ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片面包。
words.en: A slice of something is a thin piece or portion of it.

words.ex: The plane began its descent at 10,000 feet.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在一万英尺高度开始下降。
words.en: The act of moving or falling downward.

words.ex: Birds inhabit the forest near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类居住在湖边的森林里。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.ex: The family is in a difficult plight after losing their home.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在失去家园后陷入了困境。
words.en: A plight is a difficult or adverse situation, especially one that is hard to escape. It can also refer to a solemn promise or pledge.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: He gave a bold speech in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前发表了大胆的演讲。
words.en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

words.ex: He is a skilled carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名有技能的木匠。
words.en: Having the ability and experience to do something well.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: The farmer ploughs the field every spring.
words.ex_cn: 农民每年春天都犁地。
words.en: A plough is a large farming implement with one or more blades fixed in a frame, drawn over soil to turn it over and cut furrows in preparation for the planting of seeds. It can also mean to move forward with difficulty or to work hard at something.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
words.en: A bolt is a type of fastener consisting of a threaded pin or rod with a head at one end, designed to be inserted through holes in assembled parts and tightened by a nut from the other end. It can also refer to a sudden dash or run, or to eat food quickly and without chewing.

words.ex: He has a slight cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有点轻微的感冒。
words.en: A slight change, difference, or action is not very great or important.

words.ex: He endow a library with books.
words.ex_cn: 他捐赠了一图书馆的书。
words.en: If someone is endowed with a particular quality or ability, they naturally have it.

words.ex: He inhale the fresh air in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他早上吸入新鲜空气。
words.en: To inhale means to breathe in air, smoke, or gas.

words.tr:
n. 塞子；
v. 插上；
words.ex: The sink is clogged because the plug is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 水槽堵塞了，因为塞子卡住了。
words.en: A plug is a small object at the end of a wire that is used for connecting a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity. It is also a piece of material that is used for blocking a hole.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: Exercise can bolster your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的健康。
words.en: If you bolster something such as someone's confidence or courage, you increase it. A bolster is also a long, firm pillow.

words.ex: The stone skimmed over the water.
words.ex_cn: 石头掠过水面。
words.en: To remove a substance from the surface of a liquid, or to read or consider something quickly in order to understand the main points, without studying it in detail.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: He had to endure the cold winter without a coat.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在没有外套的情况下忍受寒冷的冬天。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.ex: Honesty is an inherent quality of a good leader.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是好领导固有的品质。
words.en: Existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.ex: Drugs can relieve pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To relieve someone or something means to make a problem, pain, or unpleasant feeling less severe or to take it away completely.

words.tr:
n. 炸弹
v. 投弹于；轰炸
words.ex: The bomb exploded at noon.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹在中午爆炸了。
words.en: A bomb is a device which explodes and damages or destroys a large area.

words.ex: The sun burned his skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒伤了他的皮肤。
words.en: Your skin is the natural outer covering of your body.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: He built his endurance by running every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早晨跑步来增强耐力。
words.en: The ability to endure an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving up.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.tr:
v. 投入；跳入
n. 跳进；骤降
words.ex: He plunged into the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他跳进了冰冷的水里。
words.en: If something or someone plunges in a particular direction, especially into water, they fall, rush, or throw themselves in that direction.

words.tr:
v. 喜欢；享受；从…获得乐趣
n. 享受；乐趣；调味品
words.ex: He relishes every bite of his favorite food.
words.ex_cn: 他享受着每一口他最喜欢的食物。
words.en: If you relish something, you enjoy it very much.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.ex: The climax of the movie was a big chase scene.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的高潮是一场大追捕场景。
words.en: The climax is the most exciting or important part of a play, film, or piece of music, which usually happens near the end.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.ex: The medicine helps inhibit pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制疼痛。
words.en: If something inhibits an event or process, it prevents it or slows it down.

words.tr: adj. 复数的； n. 复数；
words.ex: The word 'cats' is a plural form.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'cats' 是复数形式。
words.en: The plural form of a word is the form that is used when referring to more than one person or thing.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.ex: The skull protects the brain.
words.ex_cn: 颅骨保护大脑。
words.en: The bony framework of the head that encloses the brain and supports the structures of the face.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.ex_cn: 男孩会爬树去拿球。
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.ex: The story had a graphic description of the battle.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事对战斗的描述非常生动。
words.en: A graphic is a visual representation of data or information, such as a chart, diagram, or picture.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.tr:
prep. 加；加上；
conj. 加；和；并且；
n. 优势；
words.ex: Five plus three is eight.
words.ex_cn: 五加三等于八。
words.en: Used to indicate addition, or a positive quality or factor.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.ex: The skyscraper is very tall and has many floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座摩天大楼非常高，有很多层。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

words.ex: I watched a clip of the movie on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我在YouTube上看了这部电影的一个片段。
words.en: A clip is a small device, usually made of metal or plastic, that is specially shaped for holding things together. As a verb, to clip means to cut something, especially to make it shorter or neater.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.ex: He works in a medical center.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家医疗中心工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of medicine.

words.ex: He eats fiber to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃纤维来保持健康。
words.en: A fiber is a thread or a structure or object resembling a thread, especially one that is used to make cloth or rope.

words.tr:
v. 发抖；打颤；战栗；焦虑
n. 震颤；发抖；战栗
words.ex: The old man tremble in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 老人在寒风中发抖。
words.en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

words.tr: v. 砰地关上；猛地一动；抨击
words.ex: He slammed the door angrily.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把门砰地关上。
words.en: If you slam a door or window, or if it slams, it shuts noisily and with great force.

words.tr:
n. 斗篷；掩护物
v. 隐瞒；掩饰
words.ex: He wore a black cloak to hide his face.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色斗篷来遮住脸。
words.en: A cloak is a long, loose outer garment which is worn over other clothes, especially in cold weather. It can also refer to something that hides or covers another thing.

words.ex: He showed gratitude for the help.
words.ex_cn: 他表达了对帮助的感激。
words.en: Gratitude is the feeling of being thankful and appreciative.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.tr:
v. 拍；掴；拍击
n. 拍；掴；拍击
words.ex: He slapped the table in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地拍了桌子。
words.en: If you slap someone, you hit them with the palm of your hand.

words.tr:
adv. 顺时针方向地
adj. 顺时针方向的
words.ex: Turn the knob clockwise to open the jar.
words.ex_cn: 顺时针转动旋钮来打开罐子。
words.en: Moving in the same direction as the hands of a clock.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.ex: The workers dug a trench to lay the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设管道。
words.en: A trench is a long, narrow ditch. In warfare, trenches are dug by troops to provide shelter from enemy fire.

words.tr:
v. 屠宰；屠杀
n. 屠宰；屠杀
words.ex: Farmers slaughter pigs for meat.
words.ex_cn: 农民宰猪取肉。
words.en: The killing of animals for food; the killing of a large number of people in a cruel or violent way.

words.ex: The scientist created a clone of the sheep.
words.ex_cn: 科学家克隆了一只羊。
words.en: A clone is an organism or cell produced asexually from one ancestor or stock, to which they are genetically identical.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.ex: We will meet at the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将在公园见面。
words.en: To come into the presence of someone by chance or arrangement.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: The usage of this machine is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器的使用非常简单。
words.en: The way in which something is used or the fact of being used.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.ex: The country made a declaration of independence.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家发表了独立宣言。
words.en: A declaration is a formal statement or announcement.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: He works at a small pharmacy near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一家小药房工作。
words.en: A pharmacy is a shop or a department in a shop where medicines are prepared and sold.

words.ex: The company used a short slogan to attract customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司用了一个简短的口号来吸引顾客。
words.en: A short and striking or memorable phrase used in advertising or politics.

words.ex: The court punished the man for rape.
words.ex_cn: 法院因强奸罪惩罚了那个男人。
words.en: Rape is the crime of forcing someone to have sex with you, especially by using violence.

words.ex: The bike has a metal chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一条金属链条。
words.en: A chain consists of connected links which are typically made of metal, used for fastening or securing something, or for transmitting mechanical power.

words.ex: The president will declare a holiday next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将在下周宣布放假。
words.en: If you declare something, you state it formally, publicly, or officially.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.ex: He is a member of the school club.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校俱乐部的成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, organization, or team.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上读书。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: He did a good deed for his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他为邻居做了一件好事。
words.en: A deed is something that is done, especially something that is very good or very bad. It can also refer to a legal document that is signed and delivered, especially one regarding the ownership of property or legal rights.

words.ex: They had a feast on New Year's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他们在元旦举办了一场盛宴。
words.en: A feast is a large and special meal, often to celebrate something.

words.tr: n. 会员资格；全体会员；
words.ex: He paid $50 to get membership of the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了50美元以获得健身房的会员资格。
words.en: Membership is the state of being a member of a group or organization.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.ex: The coin fell into the slot.
words.ex_cn: 硬币掉进了狭槽里。
words.en: A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container, for example a hole that you put coins in to make a machine work.

words.tr: n. 大量同时出现的事件；
words.ex: There was a rash of burglaries last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月发生了一连串的盗窃案。
words.en: If someone is rash or does rash things, they act without thinking carefully first, and therefore make mistakes or behave foolishly.

words.tr: n. 主席；主持人；董事长；
words.ex: The chairman called the meeting to order.
words.ex_cn: 主席宣布会议开始。
words.en: A chairman is a man who is in charge of a meeting, committee, or organization.

words.ex: The default setting is on.
words.ex_cn: 默认设置是开启的。
words.en: If a person, company, or country defaults on something that they have legally agreed to do, such as paying a debt or keeping to an agreement, they fail to do it.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain without oxygen was a great feat.
words.ex_cn: 在不吸氧的情况下爬山是一项伟大的壮举。
words.en: A feat is an act or achievement that shows great courage, skill, or strength.

words.ex: The broken bridge is a menace to drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这座破桥对司机来说是个危险物。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a menace, you mean that they are likely to cause serious harm.

words.ex: The pilgrim walked to the holy place.
words.ex_cn: 朝圣者步行前往圣地。
words.en: A pilgrim is a person who journeys to a sacred place for religious reasons.

words.ex: Many families live in the slum near the city center.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在城市中心附近的贫民窟里。
words.en: A slum is a heavily populated urban area characterized by substandard housing and squalor.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.tr: n. 房间；室；腔；大会议室；
words.ex: He sat in the chamber and waited quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在房间里安静地等待。
words.en: A chamber is a large room, especially one that is used for formal or public events.

words.tr:
n. 失败；
v. 击败；战胜；
words.ex: The team accepted the defeat with pride.
words.ex_cn: 球队以自豪的态度接受了失败。
words.en: If you defeat someone, you win a victory over them in a battle, game, or contest.

words.ex: The bird has a soft feather.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟有一根柔软的羽毛。
words.en: One of the light, horny structures that form the principal covering of birds.

words.ex: He will mend his broken shoe.
words.ex_cn: 他将修补他破掉的鞋子。
words.en: If you mend something that is broken or damaged, you repair it, so that it works properly or so that it looks like new again.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.tr:
n. 猛跌；衰退；萧条期
v. 急剧下降；暴跌；重重地坐下（或倒下）
words.ex: The company's sales went into a slump last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月，这家公司的销售额下滑了。
words.en: If something such as the value of something slumps, it falls suddenly and by a large amount.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.ex: He will defer his trip until next month.
words.ex_cn: 他将把旅行推迟到下个月。
words.en: If you defer an event or action, you arrange for it to happen at a later date, rather than immediately or at the previously planned time.

words.ex: The bird glide smoothly over the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在湖面上滑行。
words.en: To move smoothly and continuously along, as if without effort or resistance.

words.ex: They persecute people for their beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他们因人们的信仰而迫害他们。
words.en: If someone is persecuted, they are treated cruelly and unfairly, often because of their race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: The old temple has four stone pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙有四根石柱。
words.en: A pillar is a tall solid structure, which is usually used to support part of a building.

words.tr: adj. 诡诈的；诡秘的；心照不宣的
words.ex: The sly fox stole the chicken at night.
words.ex_cn: 那只狡猾的狐狸在夜里偷了鸡。
words.en: Someone who is sly is clever and good at deceiving people in a way that is not easily noticed.

words.ex: The reader enjoyed the novel very much.
words.ex_cn: 这位读者非常喜欢这本小说。
words.en: A person who reads or who is fond of reading.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: The defect in the phone made it hard to use.
words.ex_cn: 手机的缺陷让它很难使用。
words.en: A defect is a fault or imperfection in a person or thing.

words.tr: adj. 黑暗的；幽暗的；忧郁的；沮丧的
words.ex: The room was gloomy with no windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有窗户，很黑暗。
words.en: If a place is gloomy, it is almost dark so that you cannot see very well. If people are gloomy, they are unhappy and have no hope.

words.ex: He persevered despite many failures.
words.ex_cn: 尽管多次失败，他仍然坚持不懈。
words.en: If you persevere with something, you keep trying to do it and do not give up, even though it is difficult.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.ex: He smashed the glass with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把玻璃打碎了。
words.en: To break something into pieces violently and noisily, or to cause something to do this by dropping, throwing, or hitting it.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: The chancellor announced a new tax policy.
words.ex_cn: 大臣宣布了一项新的税收政策。
words.en: A chancellor is the head of the government in some countries, or a high-ranking official in a university or other institution.

words.ex: His deficiency in math made him struggle in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的缺乏让他在课堂上很吃力。
words.en: A deficiency is a lack or shortage of something that is needed.

words.ex: The sun shone with great glory at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，太阳闪耀着辉煌的光辉。
words.en: High renown or honor won by notable achievements; magnificence or great beauty.

words.ex: The rain persisted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨持续了一整天。
words.en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.tr:
v. 争吵；吵架；
n. 争吵；口角；
words.ex: They quarrel over small things every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天为小事争吵。
words.en: A quarrel is an angry argument or disagreement between people.

words.ex: The city has heavy smog in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市冬天有严重的雾霾。
words.en: Smog is a mixture of smoke and fog, or a similar mixture of air pollutants, which can be harmful to health.

words.ex: She readily agreed to help me.
words.ex_cn: 她很容易就同意帮我了。
words.en: If you do something readily, you do it in a way which shows that you are very willing to do it.

words.ex: The room was in chaos after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对之后，房间一片混乱。
words.en: A state of complete disorder and confusion.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.ex: The glorious sunset lit up the whole sky.
words.ex_cn: 辉煌的日落染红了整个天空。
words.en: Something that is glorious is very beautiful and impressive.

words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.ex: He bought a quart of milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了一夸脱牛奶。
words.en: A quart is a unit of measurement for liquids, equal to two pints or approximately 1.14 liters.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.tr:
adj. 退步的；堕落的；腐化的
v. 退化；堕落
n. 堕落的人
words.ex: The old machine became degenerate and stopped working.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧机器退步了，停止工作了。
words.en: If you say that someone or something degenerates, you mean that they become worse in some way, for example, poorer, weaker, or less respectable.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: His persuasion helped me change my mind.
words.ex_cn: 他的说服让我改变了主意。
words.en: Persuasion is the act of persuading someone to do something or to believe that something is true.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.ex: He tried to smuggle cigarettes across the border.
words.ex_cn: 他试图走私香烟过境。
words.en: To smuggle goods or people means to move them into or out of a country illegally.

words.ex: He worked hard and reaped the rewards.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，获得了回报。
words.en: To reap means to cut and gather a crop, or to obtain something, especially as a result of effort.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: The newspaper's headline said 'City Wins Championship'.
words.ex_cn: 报纸的大字标题写着‘城市赢得冠军’。
words.en: A headline is the title of a newspaper story, printed in large letters at the top of the story, especially on the front page.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: He stayed in quarantine for 14 days.
words.ex_cn: 他隔离了14天。
words.en: A quarantine is a period of time during which an animal or person that might have a disease is kept away from other people or animals so that the disease cannot spread.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.tr: v. 喷射；喷出；驱逐；逐出
words.ex: The volcano ejects lava during an eruption.
words.ex_cn: 火山在喷发时喷出岩浆。
words.en: If you eject someone or something from a place, you force them to leave.

words.tr: n. 总部；司令部；指挥部；
words.ex: The company's headquarters is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a company, organization, or military unit.

words.ex: He buys petrol every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五买汽油。
words.en: A liquid obtained from petroleum, used especially as a fuel in cars.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.ex: He grew a thick beard last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天他留了一脸浓密的胡须。
words.en: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

words.ex: The Magna Carta is an old charter of rights.
words.ex_cn: 《大宪章》是一份古老的权力宪章。
words.en: A charter is a formal document describing the rights, aims, or principles of an organization or group of people.

words.tr:
v. 逝去；过去
n. （光阴）逝去
words.ex: Two hours elapsed while he waited for the bus.
